title: Konfigurationsschlüssel nach INTERFACES.md §2.1 (Vertrag 1)
description: Je Datei ein Schema unter $defs. Unbekannte Schlüssel sind ein Startfehler (additionalProperties false), jede Datei beginnt mit version = 1. x-typ ist der Typ, wie ihn §2.1 schreibt; pruefe_konfig.py vergleicht Schlüssel, x-typ und default mit dem Text.

keylock_maschine.x-quelle: Umbauplan 2026-10-09-bungee-umbau S2: r3 = Rubber Band in Fäden (Rückfall, Vorgabe bis S8); bungee = Bungee synchron im Callback, Korn 512; bungee_fein = Korn 256. Bungee nur in einem mit CYPHERDJ_BUNGEE gebauten Kern.

keylock.x-quelle: Keylock Task 3 (Plan 2026-10-06-keylock-echtzeit.md): Dehner und Fäden im Kern; false: Kern ohne Dehner, die Decks spielen Varispeed, der Regler keylock (§1.5) wirkt nur auf die Loop-Boxen.

kanal_limiter_vorhalt_ms.x-quelle: 1.15 mix tools, D8: lookahead of the channel limiters on bus/1..4 in ms. 0 (default) = the four limiters are not built, latency 0, the lim/* rows exist but do nothing; 0.1 to 20 builds them with this lookahead (once at construction, fixed afterwards, it sets the latency). The core builds them at start (before the audio runs) and sets the latency account to their look-ahead: round(vorhalt_ms * 48) + 2 samples, plus 12 with kanal_limiter_echtspitze (26 at 0.5 ms, 74 at 1.5 ms); every master-bound path then arrives that many samples later, the PFL, the metronome and the export alignment included. The core reports it with /e/kanal_limiter (gebaut, latenz_samples) on the first /k/hallo of a generation, and the page server passes it into GET /lage as kanal_limiter {gebaut, latenz_samples}. The schema accepts 0 to 20; only the core also rejects the gap 0 < value < 0.1 (0.05 and 25 are a start error).

kanal_limiter_echtspitze.x-quelle: 1.15 mix tools: true-peak detection (4x) of the channel limiter on bus/1..4, once at construction; true adds 12 samples of latency. The ceiling is then a dBTP held for sine material (within 0.0125 dB); for broadband noise it is measured up to +1.4 dB above (16x reference, 256 taps, +0.35 to +1.37 dB; probe_g2.cpp in ~/messungen/2026-11-03-a5b-r1-review). Cause open (not the 4x grid), follow-up package. It takes effect only while kanal_limiter_vorhalt_ms is above 0 (otherwise no limiter is built).

arr_ordner.x-quelle: D1 K1 (Spec 2.9): Arbeitsordner der Wiedergaben; leer = ~/.cache/cypherdj[-<i>]/arr, der Seiten-Server liest denselben Wert.

arr_budget_mib.x-quelle: D1 K1 (Spec 2.1): Teilbetrag des gesperrten Speichers für Arrangement-Audio, höchstens speicher_budget_mib; zählt zugleich gegen speicher_budget_mib (gemeinsames Konto mit dem Deck-Lader).

warp_faeden.x-quelle: Paket 1.13 Slice 2 (ADR 031 Teil 2): Arbeitsfäden des Warp-Werks für COMPLEX und TONES; sie laufen mit SCHED_FIFO JACK-Priorität − 6, unter den Keylock-Fäden.

graph_faeden.x-quelle: Baukasten S3b: Arbeitsfäden der Baukasten-Graphen, die einen Block voraus rechnen (Graph-Werk); sie laufen mit SCHED_FIFO JACK-Priorität − 7, unter dem Warp-Werk. 0 rechnet die Graphen synchron im Callback.

hall_faeden.x-quelle: Hall pool: worker threads for the Halls of the arrangement return strips (return 1 runs in the callback, returns 2 to n+1 on the workers), SCHED_FIFO JACK priority - 1. 0: no pool, the callback computes every Hall itself, the output is bit-equal. Fewer free physical cores than asked for: fewer workers and a start line.

hall_cpus.x-quelle: Hall pool: CPU ids of the workers, comma separated, no ranges ("1,2,3"); fewer ids than hall_faeden start as many workers as ids, with a start line. Empty: the kern picks one physical core per worker from /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/topology, only among the CPUs the process may use (unit CPUAffinity, djk-start CYPHERDJ_KERN_KERNE); the lowest allowed core (CPU 0 and its sibling) stays with the JACK thread and the rest, no worker gets the sibling of another. Only blanks count as empty (automatic). Invalid text or a duplicate is always a start error; a CPU that does not exist or is offline is a start error only when hall_faeden > 0 (with hall_faeden 0 the key is unused: a warning line, the syntax is still checked); a CPU outside the allowed mask or two SMT siblings are a warning line.

stimme_eingang.x-quelle: Voice channel for spoken commentary: the input pair ein_<k> (1 to 4) is summed into the master in front of the master limiter (the limiter ceiling holds for music plus voice), delayed by 100 ms look-ahead; a detector on the undelayed voice ducks the music by stimme_duck_db before the first syllable, holds 300 ms after the last loud sample, then releases over about 400 ms. The voice follows master/pegel. 0 (default) = off, the master is bit-identical to a kern without it. Pick a pair that no device assignment uses (the page server's input assignments write ein_* edges too).

stimme_duck_db.x-quelle: Voice channel: music gain while the voice speaks, -40 to 0 dB. Only with stimme_eingang > 0.

stimme_pegel_db.x-quelle: Voice channel: gain of the voice in front of the master limiter, -40 to +12 dB. Only with stimme_eingang > 0.
